import.progressCount: Checking {n} of {total} result… | Checking {n} of {total} results…
import.newerSchema: result {position}: schema version {version} is newer than this app
import.unchanged: Nothing in your history was changed.

refused.csv: Import accepts BitGauge JSON exports only. CSV exports are summaries and can't be restored.
refused.notJson: The file isn't JSON. Import accepts BitGauge JSON exports only.
refused.notHistory: The file isn't a BitGauge history export (format bitgauge.history, version 1).
refused.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB, the most an import reads.
refused.unreadable: The browser couldn't read the file.
refused.unavailable: History is unavailable in this browser mode — results are not saved.
refused.writeFailed: The browser refused to store the results.

export.csvSub: One row per test · summary only
export.warning: Contains client IP addresses, labels and notes. Files are created in your browser.
export.invalid: A stored result failed validation, so the JSON export was not created.

clear.title: Clear all history?
clear.body: This removes {n} result with its label and note from this browser. This cannot be undone. Export first if you want a copy. | This removes {n} results with their labels and notes from this browser. This cannot be undone. Export first if you want a copy.

origin.title: Stored only in this browser, for {origin}
origin.body: Browsers keep site data per address — scheme, host and port. Opening BitGauge at another address, such as its IP address instead of its name, or another port, shows a separate, empty history. The server keeps no results. Export JSON to move them.

safari.title: Safari may delete this history
safari.body: Safari removes site data for sites you haven't opened in 7 days of browsing. Export a JSON copy to keep your results.

empty.title: No results yet
empty.body: Each finished test is saved here automatically, with its label and note. Run a test on this device, or import a JSON export from another browser.

unavailable.title: History isn't available in this window
unavailable.body: History is unavailable in this browser mode — results are not saved. The browser isn't letting this site store data, usually because this is a private window. Tests still run, and you can download each result as JSON. Open BitGauge in a normal window to keep history.

noMatch.title: No results match these filters
noMatch.label: with label {values}
noMatch.still: The {n} result is still in history. | All {n} results are still in history.

trend.title: Trend
trend.single: Trends appear from the second result.

compare.title: Compare results
compare.description: Change is B relative to A
compare.descriptionPaged: Change is shown on B, relative to A
compare.label: Label
compare.copyManual: The browser didn't allow copying: select the text below and copy it.
